name: Forerunner K2
summary: A full-size industrial humanoid from Shanghai's Kepler Robotics, which designs and makes its own planetary roller-screw linear actuators and 11-DOF hands. Kepler has aimed at a comparatively low price for a full-size machine and at export sales to research and integration partners.
notable: Vertically integrated: in-house roller-screw actuators and hands
Low price point for a full-size industrial humanoid
